headline: SIMEI opens at Rho as the ISF Congress closes at MiCo
taxi: Rho at fair closing (~18:00); CityLife busy with Big Buyer and ISF departures; light rain adds demand.
linate: ISF delegates leaving and international SIMEI buyers arriving.

headline: SIMEI at Rho, Big Buyer's last day and World Business Forum opens at MiCo
taxi: Rho at ~18:00 closing; CityLife morning arrivals and ~18:00 exits.
linate: International SIMEI buyers and World Business Forum attendees arriving.

headline: AutoClassica opens at Rho alongside SIMEI; World Business Forum closes
taxi: Rho at ~18:00 closing; CityLife exits ~18:00; showers may add demand.
linate: Fair visitors arriving; Forum attendees leaving in the evening.

headline: CGIL general strike, but ATM runs normally; Muse at Unipol Dome tonight
taxi: Morning detours around the march from Piazza Cadorna; Santa Giulia exits after Muse (~23:00); rail strike from 21:00 pushes late arrivals to taxis.
linate: Flights excluded from the strike; normal Friday departures plus fair visitors.

headline: Muse's second night at Unipol Dome, Korn at Assago, AutoClassica and a rail strike until 20:00
taxi: Stations short of trains during the day; Rho at fair close; Santa Giulia and Assago exits around 23:00.
linate: ENAV strike revoked; weekend arrivals for Muse and AutoClassica, some rail travellers switching to flights.

headline: AC Milan – Frosinone at San Siro, AutoClassica closes, all-day ENAV strike at Malpensa
taxi: San Siro exits ~20:00; Rho at fair close; rain adds demand.
linate: Some Malpensa traffic may shift to Linate; check flights.

headline: Quiet Monday after a busy weekend
taxi: Normal weekday demand; no big evening events found.

headline: Il Salone dei Pagamenti opens at MiCo
linate: Payments-industry visitors arriving; usual Tuesday business traffic.
